mandatory_prevalue_support_predicate_gat.mathematical_support_check: Because every finite directional percentile is strictly positive and at most 32 exact-zero missing states are allowed, the 33rd order statistic is necessarily an observed finite component score.

mechanism_family_review.reason: Campaign044 averaged 66 ranks only on their all-finite common cross-section. Campaign101 uses the complete current 129 numeric library, independent finite-base ranks, worst-state missing scores, and the 33rd order statistic. Holding the arithmetic mean fixed while moving mass across the lower quartile can change Campaign101, and holding the lower quartile fixed while changing upper ranks can change the mean.
All 129 v54 numeric sources remain in exact order, including failed terminal factors and Campaign100. No source is selected or weighted by return evidence, and no old terminal record is reclassified.

Missing components receive the worst directional state zero, never a favorable or neutral fill. The 97-component floor is checked before comparison values or returns, and the no-return coverage gates may still reject the candidate.
After coverage only, the candidate must pass the strict absolute median daily rank-correlation ceiling against every one of the 129 frozen numeric source factors in exact order.
Campaign101 has one fixed order statistic, no coefficient, intercept, alternate quantile, subset, regularization, interaction, tree, neural model, regime, or parameter grid.
The combination is historical research only and cannot create current scores, a stock list, allocation, order, Candidate49 mutation, or second prospective ledger.

algebraic_and_counterfactual_checks_befo: If every one of the 129 directional component scores weakly increases for a stock-day with fixed availability, the candidate cannot decrease.
Changing only one of the 97 highest component scores usually leaves the 33rd order statistic unchanged, distinguishing the candidate from an arithmetic mean and from any one upper-tail source.
Changing a component across the 33rd order boundary can change the candidate while keeping the complete-library arithmetic mean fixed through an offsetting upper-tail change.

With exactly 32 unavailable components, all 32 exact zeros sort below the strictly positive finite percentiles and the 33rd value is the smallest finite component; with fewer missing components it is a higher finite order statistic.
A constant finite source gives equal average-tie percentile contributions within its session and remains in the 129-vector; it is never silently dropped.
Changing Candidate49, a semantic-only definition, a forward return, daily execution price, or provider state cannot change the frozen historical candidate.
